summary: OFF 360 iteration 5 — full BE+FE regression of new purchase flow. NEW backend suite (/app/backend/tests/test_off360_new_flow.py) with 11 tests: 11/11 PASS. Covers: super_admin login returns must_change_password=True + role=super_admin (NOT completed to preserve temp password); consumer scan creates pending_validation tx returning transaction_id; unknown QR -> 404 'QR Code inválido'; unconfigured establishment -> 400 'não configurou as condições do desconto'; merchant confirm with gross_amount below discount_min_purchase -> 400 'compras a partir de R$ 50.00'; cap enforcement (200 * 15% = 30 capped to 5 -> final 195); happy path scan->confirm->consumer sees status confirmed; role isolation on scan/confirm; consumer economy persistence across sessions. UI (Playwright, mobile+desktop viewports) validated: (a) benefit-screen renders with countdown 10:00 mm:ss, establishment name 'Cafeteria Grão Nobre', 15% and code; (b) /scan has ZERO manual input elements (data-testid scan-manual-input/toggle/submit count=0) — camera-only enforced; (c) /merchant/validate shows amount-<id> + confirm-<id>; entering 80 and confirming transitions consumer's /transaction/<id> to tx-confirmed 'TRANSAÇÃO CONFIRMADA'; (d) consolidated /merchant with 'Todos os estabelecimentos' renders 6 cards, 6 manage-<id> and 6 viewqr-<id> buttons; (e) GERENCIAR routes to /merchant/establishment and VER QR CODE to /merchant/qr; (f) add-est-btn shows '(6/10)' counter next to it (Adicionar\n(6/10)); (g) add dialog does NOT contain 'R$ 49,90' anywhere; 'valor ainda não definido / a definir' text present; (h) /merchant/qr with an unconfigured est (e.g., 'Unidade Teste 2') shows qr-configure-discount button which routes to /merchant/establishment; (i) consumer -> /api/merchant/establishments = 403 and /api/admin/overview = 403 (role isolation). Existing suites: 4 of 29 legacy tests failed but ALL are stale-test issues referencing removed OLD flow (POST /api/consumer/transactions no longer exists; admin@off360.com now suspended per test_credentials.md), NOT app bugs.

critical_code_review_comments: Login response for /api/auth/login returns fields at the TOP level (id, role, must_change_password, ...) instead of a nested {user:{...}, token}. Not a bug but inconsistent with common conventions and prior test assumptions.

est-selector is a shadcn Radix combobox (role=combobox button), not a native <select>. Tests targeting est-selector must use click + get_by_role('option'). Consider adding data-testid on each option (e.g., est-option-<id>) for robust targeting.
